title: Wealth Company Launches Category III AIF in GIFT City for NRI Mutual Fund Investments
summary: Wealth Company launched Category III AIF ('Wealth Company IFSC FoF') in GIFT City IFSC for NRIs to invest in Indian MFs and ETFs.

blocks.content: Wealth Company launched Category III AIF ('Wealth Company IFSC FoF') in GIFT City IFSC for NRIs to invest in Indian MFs and ETFs.

items: **Fund Vehicle:** 'The Wealth Company IFSC FoF' registered as open-ended **Category III Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)**.
**Regulator & Manager:** Managed by Wealth Company Asset Management IFSC branch registered with **IFSCA**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: IFSCA Headquarters: GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Chairman: K. Rajaraman.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **AIF Category:** Registered specifically as Category III AIF (Fund of Funds).
